signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch home set back behind a large front lawn; house partially obscured by young trees.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Very neat, recently mulched beds with boulders, staked young trees, and edged lawn suggest a high level of care, but no crew, equipment, or service signage is visible.

signals.notes: Well-maintained ranch home with heavily landscaped, freshly mulched front beds and newly planted staked trees; vehicles visible at the left edge appear to belong to the neighboring property, and a white vehicle at the right edge sits beyond the garage.
